examples.text: to create beer, wine, and other alcoholic drinks. The sugars in overripe fruit attract microscopic organisms known as yeasts. As the yeasts feed on the fruit sugars they produce a compound called ethanol— the type of alcohol in alcoholic beverages.

source.text: A brief history of alcohol - Rod Phillips

relations.reason: 例句中 yeasts 是产生 ethanol 的微生物来源，学习 ethanol 时跳转到 yeasts 有助于理解其生物生成机制。
